description_en: Enables multiple jobs at a time
name: BatchEnableJobs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace to which the job belongs. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属命名空间ID，在控制台命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the job belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The job IDs. Multiple job IDs are separated with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID列表，多个任务ID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: job_id_list
